shortDescription: South Africa's net foreign reserves rose to $73.69 billion at the end of August from $71.76 billion in July, central bank data  on Monday.Gross reserves increased to $75.95 billion in August from $73.45 billion in the prior month.

children: South Africa's net foreign reserves rose to $73.69 billion at the end of August from $71.76 billion in July, central bank data  on Monday.
Gross reserves increased to $75.95 billion in August from $73.45 billion in the prior month.
